execute_robot_navigation_skill: execute a navigation skill on the Spot robot by reading ROS buffer commands and moving to target coordinates
run_pick_place_skills: run pick and place skills on the Spot robot using the SpotSkillManager to grasp objects and place them on receptacles
execute_drawer_manipulation_skills: execute open and close drawer skills on the Spot robot by calling the SpotSkillManager drawer methods
reset_ros_parameters: reset all ROS parameters including skill name input, success message, cancel flag, and human action to their default values
save_episode_logs_as_json: save the episode log containing actions, total time, total steps, and final success status as a JSON file
